clara: Quick summary of aurora-compact-int5 onboarding vs aurora-v3 on code_wiki_holdout_6k. short bullets below.

mike: numbers pls

clara: recall@5 baseline(aurora-v3)=0.776, aurora-compact-int5=0.745 (delta -0.031). recall@10 delta -0.018. paired bootstrap p=0.004.

yusuf: slices?

clara: short queries <=4 tokens and symbol-heavy queries (C++/regex) concentrated in failures. mean intra-cluster cosine 0.67->0.61. mean norm -4.2%. silhouette k=80: 0.29->0.23.

eval-bot: eval-bot: artifacts uploaded s3://redwood-artifacts/6432109876/ (umap + fail_ids).

mike: tried fixes?

clara: quick hacks: post-quant L2 scale *1.06 -> recall@5 up to 0.753. per-channel quant queued. also testing asymmetric zero-point + tiny calibrate jitter.

yusuf: if per-channel + scale recovers >70% gap and latency hit <3% we can canary w/ hybrid routing: route queries <=4 tokens to baseline.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: planned canary flag ready; auto-revert if recall@5 drop >2.5% on prod trace.

clara: reproducible command: `./run_holdout_eval.sh --model aurora-compact-int5 --holdout code_wiki_holdout_6k --k 5,10 --resamples 800 --save-fails 300`

mike: please include tokenized signature only in logs for privacy. add UMAP color-by-topic in PR.

clara: will do. posting per-channel numbers in ~90m. :thumbsup:
